object.Text: for decision records; the study/chronicle/registry-row provisions stand
- same seed + pins => byte-identical worlds and artifacts; the seed is a world's identity
- floats quantized to 8 significant digits at serialization boundaries ONLY (kernel/src/quantize.rs)
- no wall-clock time; no HashMap/HashSet (clippy.toml disallowed-types)
- stream labels and consumption order are save-format contracts (docs/decisions/0006-*)
- regenerate all: make rebaseline (censuses skip by default)
- census regen is LOCAL (decisions 0063/0081): bash scripts/census-run.sh, once per campaign pre-merge
- byte-golden test fixtures: make rebaseline-goldens (REBASELINE=1 accept path; kernel/src/golden.rs)
- census review surface: make lab-diff STUDY=<name>
- historical pre-<campaign> pins are frozen history: scripts/freeze-fixture.sh, never rebaselined
- docs/README.md — what knowledge lives where and how ideas flow
- docs/decisions/ — {decision_count} ratified records (append-only; grep before relitigating)
- book/src/frontier/idea-registry.md — the idea registry (check before proposing anything)
TOOL-*/PROC-* rows ARE the workflow/tooling backlog; a shipped row's Where cell records any deferred half
